title: The McKay-Navarro Conjecture for Finite Groups
exact_target: Can prime-to-p-degree characters of a finite group and its Sylow normalizer be matched compatibly with the specified Galois action?

sources.citation: L. Ruhstorfer, A. A. Schaeffer Fry, arXiv:2211.14237 (2022); Adv. Math. 483 (2025), 110369.
